scope: Bound AgentClient Turn SSE parser memory and stop the current turn stream on malformed or oversized frames.

implementation.overflow_behavior: clear partial bytes and emit a protocol error
implementation.turn_stream_behavior: mark terminal on SSE parsing errors to avoid presenting a stream after possible event loss
implementation.recovery: standalone buffer can accept a fresh valid frame after the overflow error; a live TurnStream requires a new request/replay cursor

limitation: The byte cap applies to currently unparsed buffered bytes; a single unusually large HTTP chunk with many small frames can fail closed even if each individual frame is small.
